purpose: Floating icon-only SHRESTA Assistant widget for storefront customer help.
businessRules: Closed state must follow the old reference live-chat behavior: a visually centered circular assistant icon at rest, unread ping, and hover/focus expansion that reveals Chat with us.
Launcher and quick-action icons must be unique and use-case matched: assistant chat, order tracking, product help, returns, support, and generic guidance should not share one generic icon.
Click opens an old-reference-style 380x520 wine/gold chat panel with SHRESTA Support header, online status, message bubbles, quick actions, message composer, and operating-hours note.
Messages go through /api/customer-chat and are persisted by SHRESTA-BE.
Anonymous exploration help is allowed; private order-specific help must direct customers to login/account support.
